D37.title: Strategy as a declarative SUBJECT — the compiler JUDGES, NEVER AUTHORS (declarative-only, the banned-output list enforced); every compile a hash-chained TRIAL, RECORDED, NEVER COUNTED (familyN===1 STILL; the K-door refuses without BOTH the trigger AND D33); the exit criterion the user's content-hashed kill-criterion (immutable-without-a-disclosed-re-pin); the journal local-first, consented-export-only
D37.restsOn: manifest-pins.json xManifest (the five clauses pinned VERBATIM — the banned-output list, the recording-≠-counting clause, the exit discipline, the strategy-of-one byte-identity) + the walls green in BOTH repos: S71 (the seeded suggested-allocation REFUSED + quoted; the strategy-of-one byte-identical to the standalone check; the advice wall green on every composed line) · S72 (the trial chain re-verifies on a clone; familyN===1 everywhere; the K-feed refused; the readout exact) · S73 (the silent exit edit detected; the disclosed re-pin records old/new+reason). The differential + bundle byte-identical (no verdict moved — per-position verdicts ARE the existing verdicts).
D37.signingConsequence: SIGN → the manifest scope is ratified as the engine's standing capability (it can judge what the user is actually DOING, not just one pool). The composite verdict stays D38 (parked); the trials stay recorded-never-counted; the journal stays local-first. An authored allocation, a counted trial, a silently-edited exit, or a server-side account is a Halt (THE FIREWALL). A record + a primitive — it moves no verdict and adds no advice.

D38.order: the composite strategy verdict (Manifest — NEW; a VERDICT RULE)
D38.title: an aggregate SOLID/CAUTION over a strategy's positions — SPECIFIED, conservative (an aggregate may be only as good as its WORST deciding position — degrade-only), and PARKED for the pen; until signed, a strategy renders its positions' verdicts + the composed facts, and NO aggregate pill (the absence itself labeled in the render)
D38.restsOn: manifest-pins.json deviations.D38 + the render wall: renderComposed asserts NO strategy-level verdict pill; compile's compositeVerdict is structurally null (no code path emits one); the verdict-path 7 + frozen-core 2 hashes + the differential + bundle unchanged at every gate.
D38.signingConsequence: SIGN → a composite verdict is INSTALLED (conservative, degrade-only — the strategy is capped at its worst deciding position, never lifted above it; the per-subject verdicts are the inputs, the census pre-computed at activation). Until then a strategy shows its positions' verdicts + the composed facts and NO aggregate pill — because a composite verdict is a verdict-shaped RULE and AN AGENT MAY NOT INSTALL A VERDICT RULE (the D27/D29/D30/D35 precedent). Signing it is a FUTURE act with its own census.

gateItems.IN2: the Operator's real-screen session — now ENDING WITH THE FIRST DOGFOODING ACT: the Operator authors a REAL Strategy Manifest of their ACTUAL holdings, sets priorIntent (what they meant to do before compiling), compiles it, READS the composed facts (the effective-bets fact — are the 'different' positions actually one bet? · the catch aggregation · the worst-axis · the thesis-age gate), registers a REAL exit criterion (their own content-hashed kill-criterion), and records decisionAfter/changedByCompile — the strategy memo's question (does a Reality Check change a real decision?) answered with a JOURNAL ENTRY at the gate itself; + the carried IN2 items (each new domain's catch line on a real subject, the RWA warning, the backtest results incl. every MISS, the two-tier labels, the diversification fact, the governance line, the rug artifact, the D27 caveat). OWED-OPERATOR-GATED, never simulated (LN5)
gateItems.IN4: the browser/AT/viewport a11y pass — a real assistive-tech walk of the conscious 3 screens (incl. a manifest's Composed Reality Check + its portfolio facts drawer). OWED-OPERATOR-GATED

gateItems.publication: the publication decision for THIS layer — the trees are ALREADY pushed (terminal/v0.2 + studio/sandbox); what remains is the Operator's call on whether the manifest layer publishes.

signingConsequence: with D23-D38 signed + IN2/IN4/AF4 discharged + the publication decision, the invites go out against a goalpost set before the cohort arrived — the tool now judges not just one pool but what the user is actually DOING with the pools, hands them the same content-hashed exit discipline it holds itself to, counts nothing before its trigger, prescribes nothing ever, and has measured at its own gate whether the answer changed a real human decision.
